concept.name: Quote volume
concept.definition: Quote volume is trading volume denominated in the quote currency of a trading pair, i.e., the sum over trades of price times quantity. It is the standard volume field in crypto exchange data (e.g., Binance klines report base-asset volume and quote-asset volume side by side).
concept.intuition: Instead of counting how many units traded, quote volume tells you how much money (in the pair's pricing currency) changed hands.
concept.mechanics: For each trade, multiply the execution price by the executed quantity and sum over the period; the result is expressed in the quote asset (e.g., USDT for BTC/USDT). Exchanges report it as a per-bar field alongside base volume and trade count.
concept.formula: QV = Σ_i p_i · q_i, where p_i is the trade price in quote currency and q_i is the quantity in base units.
concept.failure_modes: Comparing quote volumes across pairs denominated in different quote currencies (e.g., USDT vs EUR) is invalid without FX conversion. Quote volume inherits any wash-trading inflation present in the underlying trade data.
concept.misconceptions: Quote volume is not the number of price quotes (bid/ask updates) issued during a period — that is quote message traffic, a different concept.
concept.example: A BTC/USDT hourly bar with 100 BTC traded at an average price of 60,000 USDT has base volume 100 BTC and quote volume of roughly 6,000,000 USDT.
